session.name: cw
session.description: Opaque server-validated session cookie. Issued by registration and login.

browserAction.name: X-CredWise-Action
browserAction.description: Set this header to 1 on every state-changing JSON request. When an Origin header is present it must match a configured web origin.

SessionCookie.description: Sets or expires the HttpOnly session cookie.

Paise.description: Nonnegative INR amount in paise. 100 paise equal ₹1.

password.description: The new password must contain 12–128 UTF-8 bytes.

new_password.description: The new password must contain 12–128 UTF-8 bytes.

recovery_code.description: Single-use recovery credential displayed once. Retain privately.

employment.description: Fictional employment type. Maximum 80 UTF-8 bytes.

income_regularity.description: Null means no evidence was supplied.

rent.description: Null means no evidence was supplied.

utilities.description: Null means no evidence was supplied.

goal.description: Synthetic savings goal. Maximum 240 UTF-8 bytes.

income.description: Monthly salary plus business and other income, in paise.

expenses.description: Monthly essential and discretionary spending, in paise.

disposable.description: Income after expenses and existing EMI, before savings, in paise.

net_worth.description: Assets plus reserves less outstanding debt and other liabilities, in paise.

savings_rate.description: Monthly savings as a percentage of income. Null when income is zero.

dti.description: Outstanding debt as a percentage of annualized income. Null when income is zero.

emi_ratio.description: Monthly EMI as a percentage of monthly income. Null when income is zero.

coverage.description: Emergency reserves divided by monthly essential expenses plus existing EMI, in months. Null when this denominator is zero.

health.description: Simulated financial health index. Null when income is zero.

new_password.description: The new password must contain 12–128 UTF-8 bytes.

active.description: Submit false with current_password to deactivate your own account.

content_base64.description: Base64 of a synthetic text file or PDF of at most 262144 decoded bytes. UTF-8 text starts with CREDWISE-SYNTHETIC. PDF starts with %PDF- and includes CREDWISE-SYNTHETIC.

reason.description: A written reason is required for rejection.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication or account credentials are missing, invalid or expired.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks permission or the write-origin verification failed.

NotFound.description: The requested record does not exist.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing record or its current state.

UnsupportedMedia.description: State-changing endpoints require an application/json content type.

InvalidInput.description: The request is malformed or one of its values fails validation.

TooManyRequests.description: The configured request limit has been reached.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The database or native service is unavailable.
